capabilities: copy the entire active file to the clipboard as Markdown
prepend the filename as a top-level heading in the copied text
run the copy via a command palette command
assign the command to the mobile pull-down action
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-command way to copy a whole file's Markdown content to the clipboard, especially reachable from the mobile pull-down gesture.
summary: Clipboard utility that copies the entire contents of the active file as Markdown, optionally prepending the filename as a top-level heading.
